entities.description: Selected car-to-car radio traffic from September 11, 2026. Officers discuss prior encounters, watch a vehicle, and discuss finding a traffic violation. The selection includes an earlier report of no impairment, a remark that a DUI was dropped, and uncertainty about a headlight observation. These separated sections retain the original timestamps; the selected radio traffic does not establish the final outcome.
